description_expanded:
1640 E County Highway 30A, Unit #302 | WaterColor, FL

1640 E Co Hwy 30A Unit 302 is centrally located in the beach district of gorgeous WaterColor for an unparalleled beach retreat. Only steps away from the beach, pool, shops, and eateries this beautiful condo will provide a perfect stay along 30A.

Experience complete relaxation in this multi-level residence with accommodations for four guests in the Beach District of Watercolor. Located on the highest floors of the Watercolor condominium, the first level of unit 302 offers a bright, expansive, open concept living space with floor to ceiling windows, and creamy walls. The cozy entertainment area offers ample seating for guests and the also can be transformed into an additional sleeping area on the queen-sized sleeper sofa. Enjoy your morning soaking in the sun on the outdoor balcony directly off of the main living space, or make it the perfect end to your day with an evening glass of wine watching the sunset along 30A. The balcony is outfitted with a custom, large cocktail table.

Swiftly move to the new, custom glass top dining table that can comfortably seat 6 guests or utilize the breakfast bar with additional seating for 3 guests. The sleek kitchen provides high-end appliances for all your cooking needs and offers wonderful counter space for preparing a romantic meal or distinguished dinner. The kitchen is fulling stocked with LeCreuset stoneware. Along this floor also find the full hallway bathroom complete with shower/tub combo and a new, full size LG washer and dryer.

The second level of unit 302 features the grandmaster suite with high ceilings, wonderful views, new hardwood pine flooring, a king-sized bed, and nook seating area. The ensuite bathroom is complete with dual vanity sinks, a new custom glass door for the walk-in shower, and two new Knoll's accent chairs. The bright master suite creates the perfect getaway and also and allows access to the elevated balcony to catch a view of the Gulf of Mexico or Western Lake. This is the perfect spot for sunbathing in private during the day or star gazing in the evening.

This Watercolor central condo is ideal for a couples hide-away or those wanting to be steps away from the beach, the pool and all the happenings in Watercolor. The beautiful art found throughout this condo is furnished by local artist, Clint Eagar, in Grayton Beach.

- Fully equipped sleek kitchen that is stocked with LeCreuset stoneware

- Full hall bathroom with a shower/tub combo

2nd Floor of Condo (4th floor of building)

- Master suite with new hardwood floors, king size bed, tv, and private bathroom with double vanities and a new glass door for walk-in show

- Outdoor balcony that offers privacy for sunbathing or watching the the sunset over Western Lake and Watercolor

Additional

- Guests can enjoy complimentary rides anywhere in WaterColor using the on-demand WaterColor Trolley, available through the WaterColor Trolley app in your app store.

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

- No pet home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the no pet policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional cleaning charges.

- Watercolor condos cannot rent golf carts.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 Cancellation Fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM.

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.

- 4 Amenity Wristbands - Maximum. Extras are not available. Access to All WaterColor Community Swimming Pools - Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club.

- The HOA issues one parking pass per reservation. Guests are encouraged to park their vehicles in the driveway or garage of their rental home. They do not need a parking pass when their vehicle is parked on a private residential property.The HOA-issued parking pass is required to park a vehicle overnight on the common area parking pads.
